cases.sentence: Примерно в это же время царь Ирод арестовал некоторых членов ___.
cases.translation: About that time King Herod arrested some members of the church.
cases.explain: The noun phrase 'членов церкви' uses the genitive after 'членов' to express possession.

cases.sentence: Он приказал убить мечом Иакова, брата ___.
cases.translation: He had James, the brother of John, killed with the sword.
cases.explain: The phrase 'брата Иоанна' uses the genitive to express relationship after 'брат' (brother).

cases.sentence: Петра арестовали, заточили в темницу и выставили охрану из четырех смен ___.
cases.translation: Peter was arrested, thrown into prison, and four squads of guards were posted.
cases.explain: The phrase 'смен караула' uses the genitive to show possession: 'squads of guards'.

cases.sentence: Ирод намеревался после Пасхи вывести Петра к ___.
cases.translation: Herod intended after the Passover to bring Peter to the people.
cases.explain: The verb 'вывести к' (to bring to) requires the dative case after the preposition 'к'.

cases.sentence: В ночь перед тем, как Ирод должен был вывести его на суд, Петр спал между двумя ___.
cases.translation: The night before Herod was to bring him to trial, Peter slept between two soldiers.
cases.explain: The preposition 'между' (between) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Внезапно явился ангел Господа и камеру осиял ___.
cases.translation: Suddenly an angel of the Lord appeared and the cell was flooded with light.
cases.explain: The verb 'осиял' (illuminated) takes the instrumental case for the instrument or means of action.

cases.sentence: Когда Петр пришел в себя, он сказал, что Господь избавил его от ___.
cases.translation: When Peter came to himself, he said that the Lord had delivered him from the hand of Herod.
cases.explain: The preposition 'от' (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Петр постучал в ворота, и на стук вышла служанка по имени Рода, служившая семье ___.
cases.translation: Peter knocked at the door, and a servant girl named Rhoda came to open it, who served Mary's family.
cases.explain: The possessive phrase 'семье Марии' uses the genitive case to express possession.

reading.ru: Примерно в это же время царь Ирод арестовал некоторых членов церкви, чтобы сделать им зло.
reading.question: What was King Herod's intention in arresting members of the church?
reading.explain: The text clearly states 'чтобы сделать им зло' — in order to do them harm.

reading.ru: Петр был под стражей в темнице, а церковь горячо молилась о нем Богу.
reading.question: What was the church doing while Peter was imprisoned?
options: Earnestly praying for him to God
reading.correct: Earnestly praying for him to God
reading.explain: The text states 'церковь горячо молилась о нем Богу' — the church was earnestly praying for him to God.

reading.ru: Внезапно явился ангел Господа и камеру осиял свет.
reading.question: What happened when the angel of the Lord appeared to Peter in the prison cell?
reading.explain: The text says 'явился ангел Господа и камеру осиял свет' — the angel appeared and light illuminated the cell.

reading.ru: Когда она узнала Петра по голосу и, забыв от радости открыть ворота, побежала обратно сказать, что Петр стоит у ворот.
reading.question: What did the servant girl do when she recognized Peter's voice at the gate?
options: Forgot to open the gate in her joy and ran back to tell the others
Immediately opened the gate for him
Called the guards to arrest him
Asked him to prove his identity
reading.correct: Forgot to open the gate in her joy and ran back to tell the others
reading.explain: The text states she 'узнала Петра по голосу и, забыв от радости открыть ворота, побежала обратно сказать' — recognized Peter's voice but forgot to open the gate in her joy and ran back to tell the others.

reading.ru: Петр жестом попросил их молчать и рассказал, как Господь вывел его из темницы.
reading.question: What did Peter tell them after they opened the gate and saw him?
options: How the Lord led him out of prison
That he needed money for travel
reading.correct: How the Lord led him out of prison
reading.explain: Peter 'рассказал, как Господь вывел его из темницы' — told them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison.

reading.ru: Ирод был рассержен на жителей Тира и Сидона, и те, согласившись между собой, явились к нему и попросили мира.
reading.question: Why did the people of Tyre and Sidon come to see Herod?
options: To ask for peace because their region depended on his for food
To offer him tribute and gifts
reading.correct: To ask for peace because their region depended on his for food
reading.explain: The text indicates they came 'попросили мира, потому что их область зависела от области царя в поставке продовольствия' — asking for peace because their region depended on the king's for food supply.
